_comment_top: spaarke-ai-architecture-redesign-r1 task 009 (FR-P0-07 write half) — seed row for the dataverse.delete_record WRITE tool. GA-MCP-contract-frozen per ADR-039: sprk_toolid local segment equals the GA Dataverse MCP tool name 'delete_record'; arguments are 'tablename' + 'hasUserApproved' + 'recordId' exactly as GA (research note notes/audit-inputs/research-dataverse-mcp-2026-07.md; Learn ms.date 2026-06-05; argument shapes captured from the live GA MCP tool schemas 2026-07-05).
_comment_routing: Runtime invocation routes to DataverseDeleteRecordHandler via sprk_handlerclass. Auto-discovered (ADR-010). P2 loop projects the LLM-facing function name from sprk_toolid; sprk_name keeps the SYS- display convention required by the seed script's safety filter.
_comment_obo: spec MUST rule (task-012 audit): the delete executes through IDataverseUserClient under the calling user's OBO token. A privilege-denied delete fails with the USER's own access error — never escalated via app identity. A table invisible to the user 404s at metadata resolution BEFORE any delete.
_comment_side_effect: sprk_sideeffectclass = 100000001 (Write) — SIDE-EFFECT tool. The P2 confirmation gate (FR-P2-02, task 031) suspends/resumes this tool BY THIS DECLARED CLASS (never by tool-name list); the handler itself contains NO gating logic. The GA-frozen 'hasUserApproved' argument is contract argument semantics (must be true), NOT the platform gate.
_comment_consumption: Read by scripts/Seed-TypedHandlers.ps1. Idempotent — UPSERT by sprk_handlerclass + sprk_toolcode with sprk_name 'SYS-%' filter.
sprk_description: Deletes one row from a Dataverse table under the calling user's permissions. Proceed solely on explicit user consent: set hasUserApproved to true only after the user has affirmatively confirmed the deletion. The delete is permanent and executes with the user's own privileges; if the user cannot delete the record, the call fails with their access error. WRITE tool. Spaarke entity map: 'matter' = sprk_matter (name column sprk_mattername), 'project' = sprk_project (sprk_projectname), 'document' = sprk_document (sprk_documentname); people = contact, companies = account.
_comment_availableincontexts: 100000001 = Chat only — dataverse.* tools exist for the agent loop (P2), not playbook nodes.

sprk_jsonschema.title: dataverse.delete_record Request
sprk_jsonschema.description: Argument shape frozen against the GA Dataverse MCP delete_record(tablename, hasUserApproved, recordId) tool.

tablename.description: The logical (schema) name of the table to delete a record from (e.g. 'account', 'sprk_event').

hasUserApproved.description: Set this to true only after asking the user if they are ok with the deletion and you have received an affirmative response.

recordId.description: The GUID of the record to delete.

tablename.description: Table logical name the record was deleted from.

recordId.description: GUID of the deleted record (identifier only — the record no longer exists, so no citation is emitted).

sprk_configuration._comment: No method-discriminator dispatch — single LLM-facing function. Reserved for per-environment defaults.
